meta.themes: Agentic Development, Federal Procurement, Custom Chips, Infrastructure

news.title: OpenAI launched GPT-5.4 with native computer use, tool search, and 1M-token context
news.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5.4 across ChatGPT, API, and Codex, positioning it as a stronger model for coding, tool orchestration, and long-horizon professional workflows.

news.title: Google expanded Gemini features across Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive
news.summary: Google announced new Gemini workflows for drafting docs, generating spreadsheets, designing slides, and querying Drive context from files, email, and web inputs.

news.title: Anthropic said it would challenge the Defense Department supply-chain-risk designation
news.summary: Anthropic published a statement saying it would contest the U.S. Department of War designation in court while continuing support for active national-security transition work.

news.title: U.S. agencies began phasing out Anthropic tools and shifting workloads to OpenAI and Google
news.summary: Reuters reported multiple U.S. agencies moved to discontinue Anthropic products and redirect internal AI usage to alternative providers, signaling high-stakes procurement reshuffling.

news.title: The U.S. drafted stricter federal AI contract rules requiring broad lawful-use rights
news.summary: Reuters reported draft guidance that would require AI vendors seeking federal contracts to grant expansive lawful-use rights and disclose non-U.S. compliance-related model configurations.

news.title: Nvidia committed $4 billion across Lumentum and Coherent to expand photonics for AI processors
news.summary: Nvidia said it would invest in optical-component suppliers to improve interconnect performance and support faster AI processing in next-generation data center systems.

news.title: ASML outlined expansion beyond EUV into advanced packaging for AI chips
news.summary: Reuters reported ASML is broadening its roadmap into advanced packaging and larger-chip workflows to capture more of the AI semiconductor manufacturing stack.

news.title: Broadcom projected AI chip revenue above $100 billion by 2027
news.summary: Broadcom said demand for custom accelerators and networking remained strong, guiding to triple-digit-billion AI chip revenue visibility by 2027.

news.title: Marvell shares surged after a bullish multi-year AI chip outlook
news.summary: Marvell forecast strong multi-year growth from cloud AI infrastructure demand, reinforcing investor confidence in non-GPU AI hardware suppliers.

news.title: GitHub made Copilot code review agentic and generally available
news.summary: GitHub shipped an agentic tool-calling architecture for Copilot code review to improve contextual findings, reduce noise, and speed practical remediation.

news.title: GitHub and Figma shipped MCP flow to generate editable Figma layers from VS Code
news.summary: GitHub announced that Copilot can now use the Figma MCP server to pull design context into code and send rendered UI back as editable Figma frames.

news.title: GitHub launched Copilot coding agent for Jira in public preview
news.summary: GitHub introduced Jira assignment support for Copilot coding agent so teams can trigger autonomous draft pull requests directly from issue workflows.
